title: Login routes user to role-appropriate dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can log in from the root route and is routed to the correct dashboard layout for their role.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the employee ID field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on a role-appropriate dashboard layout

title: Complete final test and ship transformer on passing submission
description: Verifies a final tester can submit passing final test values and the transformer transitions to shipped with final test marked completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Log in as final-tester using {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Open the assigned transformers list for the final stage
Open a transformer that is in the final stage
Fill all final test fields with valid passing values
Submit the final test
Verify the transformer is marked shipped
Verify the final test status is shown as completed

title: Route transformer to admin review when HV primary winding fails

Fill the remaining required final test fields with valid values
Submit the final test
Verify the transformer is routed to the admin review stage
Verify the return target stage is shown as primary
